notes: Revision-2 R2: a root key can only come from the verifier's local trust input (--keys). A self-signed human declaration that is not in the keyset and has no cosignature tracing to a trusted human/organization key is UNVERIFIABLE E_KEY_UNTRUSTED, with N_SELF_ATTESTED_ROOT_KEY because its only signature is its own; it can never become a root by claiming an early recorded_at.
